title: French Hazelnut Pancakes
description: Fluffy French pancakes filled with hazelnut goodness, perfect for a delicious breakfast treat.
instructions: Combine pancakes mix, milk, egg, and honey in a bowl. Mix until smooth.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Pour a small amount of batter into the pan and cook until bubbles appear.
Flip the pancake and cook for another minute.
Repeat with remaining batter, making 8-10 pancakes.
In a separate pan, toast the chopped hazelnuts over low heat until fragrant.
Sprinkle the crushed knockout over the pancakes.
Top the pancakes with toasted hazelnuts and a drizzle of honey.
